data.name: Lamar
data.gender_notes: Lamar is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Lamar is of Latin origin, derived from the Latin word 'lamarus', meaning 'dark' or 'dark-skinned'. In the context of Christian names, Lamar may also be associated with the Latin word 'amare', meaning 'to love'. Thus, Lamar can be interpreted as 'beloved dark one'. The name Lamar carries the meaning “Dark, beloved” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lamar usually hope their child will grow to embody dark, beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name evoking the love and protection of God, for a child destined to shine brightly in the world.
data.etymology: Lamar belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dark, beloved.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lamar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_greek.name: Λαμάρ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Λαμάρ έχει τις ρίζες του στην εβραϊκή παράδοση και συνδέεται με την έννοια της αφοσίωσης στο Θεό. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόλο που δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα, η πνευματική σημασία του ονόματος σχετίζεται με την αφοσίωση και την υπηρεσία στον Θεό.

It carries a certain pride in one's racial identity and can be seen as a nod to African heritage.
